title: Hymn to the Giants
description: A cinematic orchestral hymn inspired by the majesty of elephants, with heavy, grounded steps suggesting their powerful movement across the savannah.

sections.title: The Story
sections.body:
Hymn to the Giants is built around the majesty of the elephant: calm, powerful and impossible to ignore.

The theme evokes the grounded, steady steps of a giant moving across the savannah. Its orchestral character leans into weight, dignity and cinematic scale, linking nature, wildlife and film scoring into one expedition.
